author: SalahNobani
quote: The game stagnated, becoming a painfully slow and drawn-out experience that detracts from the overall enjoyment. When the open world is empty and the pace is sluggish, the game loses its appeal and becomes a tedious chore that wastes hours with no real value for the **** problem is that many games rely on padding and unnecessary length to sell longer playtime on paper, but for those seeking dynamic and well-paced games, this approach is incredibly frustrating and a blatant waste of time. You enter a virtual world to have fun and unwind, not to suffer through slow mechanics and a restrictive design. The media hype surrounding such games is sometimes far greater than their actual quality.

author: SalahNobani
quote:
The most boring part of the series. I was about to die from boredom and repetition. The best thing was the boss fights.
​The puzzles were boring and made you repeat the locations and enemy fights. I deleted the game right before the last boss because I was so fed up fighting him. Even though he wasn't very difficult, I couldn't bear to keep going and finish the game.I'm not sure if I can even manage to launch the game again, just to beat that final boss

author: SalahNobani
quote: The game is very cool and its world captivated me. I liked the feeling of being in a different  areas and wandering around, but the problem is I felt like the game was just jumping around and wasting my time.Especially the cheap shots from the monsters. I don't understand why the developers would put a traps (pranks) in just to kill you, and then you respawn so far away. The traversal and fast travel in the game are also really bad, it's like it's telling me, "Just quit the game already." I've put a lot of time into it, and I don't think I'm going to finish it.
